criteria.scientific_justification_at_intro: Fundamental phase-field physical requirement: damage cannot be negative or exceed 1.0.
Thermodynamic irreversibility of crack growth: crack healing is forbidden (allowable machine eps tolerance 1e-6).
Strain energy history field H represents maximum positive elastic energy history and cannot be negative.
Committed strain energy history must be monotonically non-decreasing over simulation time at all GPs.
Discontinuous crack slit (y=0, x<=0) must strictly prevent non-physical state interpolation across the crack faces.
Software verification that Phase DOF 3 is strictly fixed during Step 2 mechanical stress equilibration.
Heuristic check of force change upon state installation; lacked rigorous basis due to mesh discretization differences.
criteria.later_modifications: Explicitly corrected in F283 to DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY without arbitrary percentage threshold.
